_doc: Goal library (spec 2026-11-03 §5): kind + where (the filter of targets; $param from the call) + make (the state to reach; $same = keep the object's value) + required params (asked when missing, never defaulted). Raw goals have the same shape. light: "day" = the goal reads bubble kinds (unreliable at dusk/night, D185): outside daylight it stops and suggests sleeping.
